cast.name: 弗拉基米尔·马拉科夫 Vladimir Malakhov

introduction: Ballet to the music of D. Shostakovich based on the tragedy of William Shakespeare "Hamlet" performed by artists of the Moscow State Ballet Theater of the USSR under the direction of N. Kasatkina and V. Vasilev. The film-performance in the original production of the choreographer S. Voskresenskaya.A new look at the great tragedy. Other times, other performers, other tasks. Here Hamlet is a strong, strong-willed man with a tormented soul.Music：Dmitry ShostakovichChoreo：S. VoskresenskayaCASTVladimir Malakhov：HamletLyudmila Vasilieva：OpheliaNadezhda Saidakova：GertrudeSergey Belorybkin：LaertesSergei Vanaev：ClaudiusAnatoly Panasyukov：Polonium
